problem.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problem.problemStatement: Given a rotated sorted array of distinct integers and a target value, return its index. If the target is not present, return -1. The solution must run in O(log n) time.
problem.input: Integer n Rotated sorted array nums Integer target
problem.output: The index of the target, or -1.
